name: unintellij
description: Make VS Code look and behave like IntelliJ IDEA (New UI / Islands).

unintellij.appearance.theme.markdownDescription: Color theme, as in IntelliJ **Settings › Appearance › Theme**. Ignored when `#unintellij.appearance.syncWithOs#` is enabled.

unintellij.appearance.syncWithOs.markdownDescription: Follow the operating system's light/dark mode, using `#unintellij.appearance.preferredDarkTheme#` and `#unintellij.appearance.preferredLightTheme#`.

unintellij.appearance.preferredDarkTheme.markdownDescription: Theme used when the OS is in dark mode and `#unintellij.appearance.syncWithOs#` is enabled.

unintellij.appearance.preferredLightThem.markdownDescription: Theme used when the OS is in light mode and `#unintellij.appearance.syncWithOs#` is enabled.

unintellij.appearance.islandsPlus.enable.markdownDescription: **Islands+** (experimental): patch VS Code's workbench CSS to get IntelliJ's rounded panels and title bar widgets. Modifies VS Code installation files and requires write access to them.

enumDescriptions: IntelliJ default keymap for the current operating system
unintellij.keymap.layout.markdownDescription: Which IntelliJ default keymap to emulate.

unintellij.keymap.disabledActions.markdownDescription: IntelliJ action IDs whose shortcut should be disabled (e.g. `SearchEverywhere`).

unintellij.searchEverywhere.includeNonPr.markdownDescription: Also search libraries and excluded files (e.g. `node_modules`) by default, like IntelliJ's **Include non-project items** checkbox.

unintellij.searchEverywhere.excludePatte.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns excluded from Search Everywhere, on top of `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#`.

enumDescriptions: Merge incoming changes into the current branch
Rebase the current branch on top of incoming changes

unintellij.vcs.changelists.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable changelists in the Commit tool window.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile:integration && vscode-test
